patch_description: This formulation uses the fact that an excellent 14-point diameter packing can be represented by seven antipodal pairs. The search is therefore performed directly on seven unoriented lines in projective 3-space rather than on 14 unconstrained points. After fixing rotational gauge freedom, only 11 angular variables plus one coherence variable remain. SLSQP minimizes the largest squared inner product between lines; the returned antipodal configuration has diameter 2 and minimum squared distance \(2-2\max|\langle u_i,u_j\rangle|\). This is a much smaller constrained problem than optimizing all 14 points and targets the relevant contact geometry directly.
